itinerary.title: Zanzibar to Selous — Game Drive & Sunset Rufiji River Boat Safari
itinerary.description: Morning pickup from your Zanzibar hotel to ZNZ Airport. Board a 45-minute scheduled charter flight to Mtemere Airstrip. Meet your guide and begin a 4x4 wildlife drive across palm savanna. Check into your riverside tented camp for lunch. In the late afternoon, embark on a 2.5-hour sunset boat safari along the Rufiji River among hippos and crocodiles. Return for dinner under the stars.

itinerary.title: Sunrise Game Drive & Return Flight to Zanzibar
itinerary.description: Early morning game drive during active predator hours to spot lions, wild dogs, and leopards. Return to camp for a full breakfast, check out, and take a final game drive en route to the airstrip. Board your flight back to Zanzibar, landing by early afternoon for private transfer back to your beach resort.
